acos.menuDescriptionShort.target: The arccosine of the incoming value in radians.

mulhi.menuDescriptionShort.target: Computes X * Y and returns the high half.

ND_UsdPrimvarReader_boolean.menuDescript.target: A node that provides the ability for shading networks to consume boolean data defined on geometry.

combine4.menuDescriptionShort.target: Combines the channels from four streams into four channels of a single output stream of a compatible type.

UsdPrimvarReader_point.menuDescriptionSh.target: A node that provides the ability for shading networks to consume point data defined on geometry.

inside.menuDescriptionShort.target: Multiplies a mask to all channels of the input.

fractal3d.menuDescriptionShort.target: Zero-centered 3D fractal noise created by summing several octaves of 3D Perlin noise.

crossproduct.menuDescriptionShort.target: Calculates the cross product vector of 2 input vectors.

clz.menuDescriptionShort.target: Returns the number of leading 0-bits in X, starting at the most significant bit position.

ND_realitykit_surface_custom_attribute_h.target: An interpolated user-defined Vector2 (Half) data that’s from the geometry modifier.

safepower.menuDescriptionShort.target:
Raises the incoming value to an exponent and assigns the sign of the base to the output.
safepow(x,y) = sign(x) * pow(abs(x), y)

RealityKitTextureCube.menuDescriptionSho.target: A texturecube with RealityKit properties. Adjustable level of detail. Input image must be in KTX file format.

pack_to_unorm565.menuDescriptionShort.target: Converts a vector of normalized values to a packed 565 color integer value.

MTL_dfdy.menuDescriptionShort.target: Returns a high-precision partial derivative of the specified value with respect to the screen space Y coordinate.

ND_UsdTransform2d.menuDescriptionShort.target: A node that applies an affine transformation to a 2d input.
